model_result.answer_summary: Decreasing predicted ammonia yield: B > C > D > A.
assumptions: Printed reduction potentials are represented exactly in hundredths of a volt, printed pKa values in tenths, and calibration yields in tenths of a mole.
The qualitative classifier requested by the problem treats a reductant more negative than the -0.88 V zero-yield calibration as passing the productive-reductant screen.
Within the passing reductant class and with triflate held constant, larger additive pKa ranks higher, following calibration rows 3 and 4.
All candidate additives A-D have the triflate counterion, as shown in the source table.
source_gaps: The source prints no measured yields for A-D and no universal kinetic law. The reported sequence is the problem-requested qualitative extrapolation; the Lean theorem for arbitrary numerical yields therefore exposes trend compatibility as a hypothesis.
